messages:
Anya (Design): quick design review — prototype for the rollback point picker is up in figma: https://figma.com/file/xxxxx/rollback-picker :eyes:
Sam (Eng): nice, looked at it. main question: how do we indicate which snapshot the user is picking when there are many small deploys?
Maria (PM): important: customers keep asking for an exact timestamp selection. they want to type a time or pick from timeline. can we support both?
Anya (Design): yes — current comp has two modes: timeline scrub + exact timestamp input. scrub shows dots for snapshots and a hover tooltip with version id + short changelist. input allows ISO or friendly like "Mar 3, 14:22"
Lee (A11y): a11y note: the hover tooltip won't be reachable by keyboard. make sure the scrub dots have focusable buttons with aria-describedby linking to the same content as tooltip. also focus order needs to be consistent with visual reading order.
Sam (Eng): implementation detail — scrub dots are virtualized list; making all dots focusable could be heavy. maybe we only expose the nearest snapshot buttons + a flyout list for full history that is a real DOM list. that list can be keyboard navigable.
Anya (Design): good call. new flow: scrub for quick scan, keyboard-accessible "History list" that expands showing full snapshots with radio select. when you pick a snapshot, the timestamp input populates.
Maria (PM): copy tweak: instead of "Pick rollback point" can we use "Choose point in time to rollback to" — clearer for non-technical users. also action button should read "Rollback to selected version" (explicit).
Lee (A11y): copy change looks good. add a visually-hidden prefix for screen readers for absolute times: e.g., "Selected time: March 3rd, 2025, 2:22 PM UTC" so they don't have to parse short formats.
Sam (Eng): sync question: what happens when the selected snapshot is from a different region or model variant? need a clear indicator and possibly a warning.
Anya (Design): mock shows a small badge next to snapshot: "region: us-west-2" or "variant: quant-v2". if mismatch with current deployment, we show a yellow warning card: "Selected snapshot differs from active deploy — fallback behaviour may change. Confirm to proceed."
Maria (PM): also add small inline help: a tooltip link "What changes on rollback?" that opens docs. customers flagged confusion around caches & KV being invalidated.
Sam (Eng): backend note: we'll need a validation step before submitting rollback — return available snapshot metadata (region, model, env) and a boolean allowed flag. UI should surface these and disable the final action if incompatible.
Anya (Design): microcopy for disabled state: "Rollback unavailable: snapshot stored in a private region. Contact support to proceed." short and scannable.
Lee (A11y): interactive states: ensure focus visible for dot buttons, radio list, and primary CTA. Contrast check: the yellow warning card passes 4.5:1? if not, use darker amber.
Anya (Design): noted. I'll run contrast in figma and update color tokens.
DeployBot: [deploy-check] snapshot-metadata API is healthy. response time 84ms.
Maria (PM): final question — should we autosuggest a safe rollback point (e.g., last known good) with a little star icon? that would speed up restores.
Sam (Eng): we can return a `recommended` flag from the service. UI would pre-select but clearly mark it as suggestion.
Anya (Design): mock: star + "Recommended" pill and a subtle outline around recommended snapshot. keyboard nav: pressing enter on recommended selects it.
Lee (A11y): ensure "Recommended" has an accessible name: "Recommended rollback point, selected because recent metrics indicate stability" (aria-label).
Maria (PM): :thumbsup: let's prioritize the history list + validation + recommended flag for the first iteration. would like copy and a11y review sign-off before we hand to eng.
Anya (Design): I'll update figma and push a new prototype with expanded history list and the accessible labels. tagging @Lee for a11y pass once done.
Sam (Eng): thanks — I'll stub the validation endpoint and return a sample payload for design to test with.
Lee (A11y): I'll schedule a quick audit once the new prototype is up.
Anya (Design): thanks team. next steps: 1) update figma (Anya) 2) stub API & sample payload (Sam) 3) a11y audit (Lee) 4) copy polish & doc link (Maria). tagging folks in thread for followups. :sparkles:
